name: azure
description: Manage Azure and Entra ID from Claude: 102 tools, the full Azure CLI one-to-one, and six interactive views. Uses your existing az login; read-only until you open the write gate.
long_description:
Read and operate Microsoft Azure and Entra ID through your own account.

Authentication uses the Azure CLI session already on your machine, so there is no key to paste and no secret stored in the bundle. A service principal can be configured instead when you need an unattended identity.

Dedicated tools cover compute, networking, storage, databases, containers, Key Vault, monitoring, cost, security and Entra ID, each annotated with its Azure CLI equivalent. For everything else the Azure CLI itself is available one-to-one: Azure CLI (Read) runs any list/show/get command, Azure CLI (Run) runs any other command, and Azure CLI Help shows a command's arguments. ARM and Microsoft Graph escape hatches remain for raw REST.

Six interactive views render inside Claude: an estate overview, a virtual machine board and a web app board with Start/Stop/Restart buttons, a cost view with a daily trend and budgets, a resource explorer, and a security posture page.

Writes are real but gated. The connector starts read-only. Set Mode to write to enable creates and updates; set Allow destructive operations as well for deletes, stops, restarts and anything else disruptive. Every write also needs an explicit confirm on the call, and Azure CLI commands are classified per command, so a delete through the CLI needs the same gates as Delete Resource. Commands that print tokens, change your CLI sign-in or read local files are refused outright. Every operation is bounded by the RBAC and Graph permissions of the signed-in identity.

Runs on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Windows has no az.exe, so the bundle resolves the Azure CLI's own interpreter rather than spawning a shell.

azure_subscription_id.title: Subscription ID (optional)
azure_subscription_id.description: Default subscription so tools can omit subscription_id. Otherwise the az default subscription is used.

azure_tenant_id.title: Tenant ID (optional)
azure_tenant_id.description: Entra tenant id. Required only for service principal auth; with Azure CLI auth it selects the tenant for tokens.

azure_client_id.title: Service Principal Client ID (optional)
azure_client_id.description: App registration client id. Leave empty to use your existing `az login` session instead.

azure_client_secret.title: Service Principal Client Secret (optional)
azure_client_secret.description: Client secret for the service principal. Stored in the OS keychain. Leave empty to use `az login`.

az_path.title: Path to az binary (optional)
az_path.description: Absolute path to the Azure CLI if it is not on PATH (common when launched by a desktop app), e.g. /opt/homebrew/bin/az.

azure_mode.title: Mode
azure_mode.description: read or write. In read mode write tools stay listed and refuse, naming this setting. Set write to let Claude create and change resources.

azure_allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive operations
azure_allow_destructive.description: true or false. The second gate for deletes, stops, deallocations, restarts, key regeneration and other disruptive operations, including the same commands through the Azure CLI tools. Has no effect unless Mode is write.

tools.name: Server Status
